# gensrc/CMakeLists.txt
#
# Optional gensrc step (the "Full" build).  When RUN_GENSRC is ON the
# Python code-generator is run, regenerating the autogenerated source files
# in the ObjectHandler and QuantLibAddin trees (mirroring ohgensrc / qlgensrc
# in the VS "full" build).  When OFF (the default) the build relies on the
# previously generated files, exactly like the VS "basic" build.  gensrc
# requires Python 3 and writes into the source tree, so it can only be
# enabled when the source tree is writable.
#
# IMPORTANT — why gensrc runs at CONFIGURE time
# ----------------------------------------------
# The addin library targets (ohlib, QuantLibObjects, AddinCpp) list their
# autogenerated .cpp files explicitly in add_library().  CMake checks that
# those source files exist when the targets are *created*, i.e. at configure
# time.  A build-time-only custom target (see ohgensrc / qlgensrc below) runs
# too late: on a pristine checkout the generated files do not exist yet, so
# the very first `cmake` configure fails with "Cannot find source file".
#
# To make a pristine "Full" build work with a single configure, gensrc is run
# here with execute_process() DURING configuration.  Because the root
# CMakeLists.txt processes add_subdirectory(gensrc) before it processes the
# ObjectHandler and QuantLibAddin subdirectories, the generated sources are
# guaranteed to exist by the time those targets are created.
#
# The ohgensrc / qlgensrc custom targets are still defined so that, on an
# incremental build, edits to gensrc metadata/templates trigger a rebuild of
# the generated sources before compilation.
#
# This file only defines the gensrc option, runs gensrc at configure time,
# and defines the gensrc build targets.  The dependency wiring
# (ohlib -> ohgensrc, QuantLibObjects -> qlgensrc) is done in the root
# CMakeLists.txt, after those library targets exist.

option(RUN_GENSRC "Run gensrc to regenerate addin source before building" OFF)

if(RUN_GENSRC)
	find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)

	# Directory containing gensrc.py (this directory).
	set(_gensrc_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

	# The ObjectHandler gensrc command (Excel, Doxygen, Loops, ValueObjects).
	set(_ohgensrc_cmd ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${_gensrc_dir}/gensrc.py -xdlv --oh_dir=..)
	set(_ohgensrc_wd  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/ObjectHandler/gensrc)

	# The QuantLibAddin gensrc command.  On Windows the Excel target (x) is
	# included; on other platforms only the C++ addin targets are generated
	# (p C++ addin, v ValueObjects, e Enumerations, l Loops, s Serialization),
	# because the Excel target writes into the Windows-only QuantLibXL tree.
	if(WIN32)
		set(_qlgensrc_flags -a)
	else()
		set(_qlgensrc_flags -pvels)
	endif()
	set(_qlgensrc_cmd ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${_gensrc_dir}/gensrc.py ${_qlgensrc_flags} --oh_dir=../../ObjectHandler)
	set(_qlgensrc_wd  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/QuantLibAddin/gensrc)

	# -------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Configure-time generation.
	#
	# Run gensrc now (unless it has already been run for this source tree)
	# so the autogenerated sources exist before the addin targets are
	# created.  A stamp file records that generation has happened; delete it
	# (or reconfigure with a clean build dir) to force regeneration.
	# -------------------------------------------------------------------
	set(_gensrc_stamp "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gensrc.configured.stamp")
	if(NOT EXISTS "${_gensrc_stamp}")
		message(STATUS "RUN_GENSRC: running gensrc for ObjectHandler (configure-time)")
		execute_process(
			COMMAND ${_ohgensrc_cmd}
			WORKING_DIRECTORY ${_ohgensrc_wd}
			RESULT_VARIABLE _oh_rc
			OUTPUT_VARIABLE _oh_out
			ERROR_VARIABLE  _oh_out)
		if(NOT _oh_rc EQUAL 0)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "gensrc (ObjectHandler) failed with code ${_oh_rc}:\n${_oh_out}")
		endif()

		message(STATUS "RUN_GENSRC: running gensrc for QuantLibAddin (configure-time)")
		execute_process(
			COMMAND ${_qlgensrc_cmd}
			WORKING_DIRECTORY ${_qlgensrc_wd}
			RESULT_VARIABLE _ql_rc
			OUTPUT_VARIABLE _ql_out
			ERROR_VARIABLE  _ql_out)
		if(NOT _ql_rc EQUAL 0)
			message(FATAL_ERROR "gensrc (QuantLibAddin) failed with code ${_ql_rc}:\n${_ql_out}")
		endif()

		file(WRITE "${_gensrc_stamp}" "gensrc ran at configure time\n")
	endif()

	# -------------------------------------------------------------------
	# Build-time regeneration targets.
	#
	# Keep the custom targets so an incremental build refreshes the
	# generated sources before compiling (the dependency wiring onto
	# ohlib / QuantLibObjects is in the root CMakeLists.txt).
	# -------------------------------------------------------------------
	add_custom_target(ohgensrc
		COMMAND ${_ohgensrc_cmd}
		WORKING_DIRECTORY ${_ohgensrc_wd}
		COMMENT "Running gensrc for ObjectHandler"
		VERBATIM)

	add_custom_target(qlgensrc
		COMMAND ${_qlgensrc_cmd}
		WORKING_DIRECTORY ${_qlgensrc_wd}
		COMMENT "Running gensrc for QuantLibAddin"
		VERBATIM)
	add_dependencies(qlgensrc ohgensrc)
endif()

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documentation — gensrc owns its own Docs build (gensrc-docs target).  Gated
# on BUILD_DOCS so the integrated build only adds it when requested.  The
# option is (re)declared here so that this value is also honoured when gensrc
# is configured on its own.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
option(BUILD_DOCS "Add targets to build the HTML documentation with Doxygen" OFF)
if(BUILD_DOCS)
	add_subdirectory(Docs)
endif()
